description: exp_g_0023 - the NO-COMPRESSION pair of exp_n_0045_H8_d48_tph256_nap7_16k. exp_n_0045 has exactly ONE CompressionMHL site: the FFN slot of each MinimalBlock, CompressionMultiHeadLUT(input_dim=384, output_dim=384, inner_in=48, inner_out=48, nap=7, tph=256, n_heads=8, hard). Here that site is replaced by a RAW FastMultiHeadLut(input_dim=384, n_heads=1, n_outputs=384, nap=7, tph=2048, hard) -- no compress projection (it routes on the full 384-d site input) and no decompress (its tables emit the full 384-d output directly). Everything else is exp_n_0045: MinimalGPT depth 6, n_embd 384, n_head 6, seq 512, vocab 32768, tied unembedder, standard Linear attention (no LUT there), AdamW, 24,576 tok/step, 16,000 steps. WARNING: this is ~8x the FFN parameters of exp_n_0045 -- tables scale as n_heads*tph*2^nap*n_outputs, and dropping the compression means n_outputs is 384 rather than the 48-wide inner width. Shared lutorch NOT modified.
